title: EntityDetailsScreen
responsibility: The details screen of an entity of any kind: contract, measurements, and the source only when it is asked for.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.index
inputs.description: Prepared history index for the selected repository and its recorded revisions.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.head
inputs.description: Exact selected source revision supplying every displayed contract, measurement and capture.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.parent
inputs.description: First parent of the selected commit, or null at a branch tip or first commit.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.scope
inputs.description: Selected branch, commit and comparison scope shared by the explorer host.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.route
inputs.description: Current explorer location, including category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entities
inputs.description: Units projected from the selected revision, including entities removed by the shown commit.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.lens
inputs.description: Host-provided readers for entity relationships, history and selected-revision details.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.client
inputs.description: Revision reader used only for commits the displayed history requests.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: Base URL for retained recorded evidence media.

inputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.onroute
inputs.description: Receives the requested explorer destination for host-controlled navigation.

outputs.name: EntityDetailsScreen.entityDetails
outputs.description: The contract, size and performance of an entity; measurements and the source by tab.

errors.name: no-registry
errors.description: A revision that stores no unit registry says so; nothing of another revision is shown.

errors.name: entity-missing
errors.description: An entity the shown revision does not hold is said to be missing, with the way back to its collection.
